name: submit-project-inquiry
displayName: Submit a Project Inquiry to Abstrakti
description: Submits a new project inquiry to Abstrakti, a creative studio in Turku, Finland offering photography, video production, graphic design & brand identity, and web design. Use this when a person wants to request a quote or get in touch about a project. Always confirm the details with the person before submitting on their behalf.

access_key.description: Public Web3Forms access key for the abstrakti.eu contact form. This is a public client-side key, not a secret.

subject.description: Optional email subject line, e.g. 'New project inquiry from Jane Doe'.

message.description: Project details, goals, or what the person needs help with.

notes: This posts directly to the studio's inbox via Web3Forms (https://web3forms.com). There is no confirmation step on the server side, so an agent should only call this after the person has reviewed and approved the message content.
